run_ml_inference_cli: run the ml_inference CLI to predict HER voltage from computational and experimental CSV data
run_ml_inference_with_features: run ml_inference with --add_features to include pymatgen elemental descriptors in the linear regression model
run_ml_inference_parity_plot: run ml_inference with --cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot comparing predicted vs experimental voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate mean adsorbate energies per bulk_id from a computational CSV or parquet file
review_ml_inference_linear_regression: review the ml_inference module to understand how LinearRegression predicts HER voltage from energy features
